sources.snippet: ClinFusion is a medical-adapted model that retains near-backbone instruction-following capability,with consistently high scores across diverse tasks (detailed scores in Supplementary Table 5) including challenging ones such as "Seer" (prognosis based on specific conditions) and structured report generation where most other medical models fail.
